title: fix(spec): FormField constraint keys converge on the landed value shapes (int lengths >= 1, digit counts >= 0)
body:
Fixes #12174

## What

`FormFieldBaseSchema`'s count-shaped constraint keys (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) converge on the value shapes the object-field surface already landed:

| key | before | after | template |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxLength` | `z.number().optional()` | `z.number().int().min(1).optional()` | #11566 |
| `minLength` | `z.number().optional()` | `z.number().int().min(1).optional()` | #11949 (maintainer ruling 2026-08-25: `minLength: 0` is a vacuous always-true declaration, refused loudly; "no minimum" = omit the key) |
| `precision` | `z.number().optional()` | `z.number().int().min(0).optional()` | #8321 |
| `scale` | `z.number().optional()` | `z.number().int().min(0).optional()` | #8321 |
| `min` / `max` | `z.number().optional()` | unchanged | they are values, not counts — bare numbers on the object-field surface too |

Mirrored from what LANDED on `origin/main` (`data/field.zod.ts` at af56546), not the card's snapshot.

## Step 1 — reader measurement (the triage-mandated fork decider)

Population: objectui @ `f7c52e2` (origin/main, fetched 2026-08-26) — full repo (`apps/` + `packages/`); objectstack @ `af56546` — public-form resolve path (`packages/rest`).

| key | reader | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| all six | objectui spec bridge | `packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/form-view.ts` `mapField` (objectui#5898) copies `maxLength`/`minLength`/`min`/`max`/`precision`/`scale` same-name onto the runtime field |
| all six | objectui plugin-form | `packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts` `normalizeSectionField` copies the same six (`fd.maxLength` … `fd.scale`) |
| `maxLength` | console FormPage | `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:548` `override.maxLength ?? def.maxLength` (objectui#5595 — the form ceiling wins), passed to the input at :1373/:1481 |
| `minLength`/`maxLength`/`min`/`max` | validation rules | `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` `buildValidationRules` → react-hook-form rules (`validation.minLength` etc.) |
| `precision` | number widget step | `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:691` `Math.pow(10, -field.precision)` |
| `scale` | number widget | `packages/fields/src/widgets/NumberField.tsx:21` |
| all six (conduit) | public-form resolve | `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` `GET /forms/:slug` serves section field rows **verbatim** (`{ ...sec, fields }` — filter-only) to anonymous renderers; no key-level read or strip server-side |

Controls (a zero without a control probe is not a reading): `placeholder`/`required`/`readonly` — known-live FormField keys — are found by the same grep at the same three merge sites (FormPage.tsx:538-548, `sectionFields.ts`, `mapField`); and the first grep pass (`git grep -- 'packages/*/src'`) returned zero for **both** target and control, exposing a pathspec fault, and was re-run with corrected paths before any zero was believed.

Verdict: **fork (a) — keys are live** ⇒ shape-tighten in place. The concrete defect: `maxLength: 0` on a form row reached the DOM as an input that accepts nothing (`0 ?? def` — `0` is not nullish, so it beat the object field's own bound).

## Why no type-conditional gate (the applicability nuance argued, per the card)

The object-field twins refuse the length keys outside `BOUNDED_STRING_FIELD_TYPES` via superRefine. That gate has no analogue here: a form row references its object field by *name* and usually omits `type`, so the referenced field's type is invisible to this schema at parse time. A gate firing only when the optional presentational `type` override happens to be authored would make validation strictness depend on an unrelated key — a trap, not a contract. Value shape is checkable on this surface; key placement stays the object field's own schema's job. (Misplaced-but-well-formed row keys are inert-and-harmless pass-throughs; malformed *values* are what measurably corrupted rendering.)

## ADR-0087

Two semantic 18 entries registered in the same PR (the #11949 lesson — #11566's deferred entry needed a follow-up card): `ui-form-field-length-malformed-refused`, `ui-form-field-precision-scale-integer-refused` (entry files under `entries/semantic/`, registry region regenerated by `gen:migration-registry`). Changeset `'@objectstack/spec': minor` carries the `registered` disposition marker, following the #11949 changeset verbatim in structure. No stored-row conversion, matching the #11566/#11949 length-pair precedent (the data-surface `scale`/`precision` conversion predates it and was not extended to lengths); a stored form view carrying a malformed row value is refused on its next authoring-path save, as the entries' acceptance criteria state.

## Liveness ledger

`packages/spec/liveness/view.json` FormField subtree row (`sections`): the blanket undrilled verdict is drilled for the six constraint keys with the measurement above (per the file's own convention — one drill level, sub-key detail in the parent note, as `publicPicker` did).

- Fixture sweep for now-refused values across `packages/` + `examples/` (grep `minLength: 0`, `maxLength: 0`, negatives, non-integer `precision`/`scale`): zero form-surface hits; all existing hits are object-field-surface fixtures already governed by the landed twins.
